sections.name: App hero
sections.description: Split hero for the mobile app: a phone mockup built entirely from tokens (rounded device frame, notch pill, mono status row, a mini daily-brief screen with KpiCard-like rows and an approve action), beside benefit copy and two text-only store badges rendered as outline buttons. No real store logos, no images.

sections.name: Notification stack
sections.description: Benefit copy beside a stack of Alfred push notifications: two collapsed cards peeking above the live one, each with app mark, name, time and a one-line message, the front card carrying the full message and an approve/defer action row. Sells push-with-judgement without a single screenshot.

sections.name: Phone row
sections.description: Three small token-built phone frames in a row, each showing one moment of a decision's day: the 07:00 brief, the traced flag with a sparkline, and the one-tap approval. Captions under each frame tell the story left to right.

sections.name: Handoff band
sections.description: Desk-to-pocket continuity band: a desktop review card and a phone frame connected by a dotted path with one phosphor-glow accent dot mid-journey. The desk raises the flag at 08:12, the pocket approves it at 08:31, and the mono footline states the promise: one decision record, every screen.
